title: audit detail session.interrupted
description: detail of audit rows with action session.interrupted: the hub marked an active session interrupted because its device stayed offline beyond AGENT_HUB_DEVICE_FAILOVER_SECONDS (ADR-086 section 2); offline_since is the hub time the device went offline. Metadata only (02-data-model.md section 2.9); every value is flat (string of printable ASCII up to 256 characters, integer, boolean or null) like the generic detail of api/org-audit.response.json.
